findings.title: Ascent faster than recommended
findings.detail: 90s spent ascending faster than 10 m/min (peak 14.0 m/min). Aim for 9-10 m/min, and slower in the last 6 m.

findings.title: Short or missing safety stop
findings.detail: Only 80s between 3-6 m on the way up. A 3-minute stop at ~5 m is strongly recommended.

findings.title: Sawtooth profile
findings.detail: 3 repeated ascents/descents of 4 m or more. Yo-yo profiles increase DCS risk.
